alternates.description: VE Option 1: Mechanically attached system instead of fully adhered membrane (same 20-year NDL warranty available; contractor notes acceptable risk profile for 28 ft single-story industrial building)
VE Option 2: Single-layer R-30 insulation instead of two-layer R-30 staggered (contractor NOT RECOMMENDED; 5-8% energy penalty)
VE Option 3: Upgrade from 60 mil to 80 mil TPO membrane; warranty upgrades to 30-year NDL
VE Option 4: Upgrade from R-30 to R-38 insulation; estimated 18-22% reduction in roof-related HVAC costs; 4-6 yr payback

VE Option 5 (Combined Optimal Package): mechanically attached + 80 mil TPO + R-38 insulation + cover board removed (per Carlisle/Firestone with mechanically attached); 30-year NDL warranty. Net cost = -$42,000 + $38,000 + $24,000 - $8,000 (cover board removal) = +$12,000

VE Option 6: Phased installation across fiscal years (Phase 1 Dec 2026 = $180,000; Phase 2 Apr 2027 = $398,000) for potential CCA tax benefits; contractor notes this would extend schedule and require winter protection of exposed deck

allowances_carried.item: Tapered insulation allowance (ponding correction, southwest quadrant)
Hazardous material testing allowance (ACM testing if suspected)

exclusions_declared: Major steel deck repairs exceeding $10,000 allowance
Major wood deck replacement exceeding $10,000 allowance
Replacement of damaged roof drains or leaders
Work outside standard hours (7 AM - 6 PM weekdays)
Hazardous material abatement beyond minor handling
Temperature monitoring equipment (we coordinate; owner to provide)
Third-party testing/inspection beyond our testing allowance
clarifications: Ponding correction: $20,000 tapered insulation allowance carried; final quantity to be confirmed during removal.
Deck conditions: $10,000 steel deck and $10,000 wood deck allowances should be sufficient for typical conditions per visual site inspection.
Hazardous materials: Building is 1998, so ACM is unlikely but possible. Testing allowance and minor handling included; major abatement would be extra.
Phasing: Schedule assumes reasonable cooperation from tenant for access and coordination.
HVAC coordination: Assumes HVAC shutdowns can be scheduled for weekends when needed; weekday shutdowns require 72-hour notice as per RFP.
Temperature monitoring: Owner to provide temperature monitoring in warehouse; contractor will coordinate around any alerts.
Cover board: Included in base bid; can be removed if VE Option 5 is selected (mechanically attached system does not require cover board per Carlisle and Firestone).
Permits: Building permits typically owner responsibility; contractor can arrange if needed (priced separately).

substitutions_proposed.spec_item: Membrane attachment (RFP allows fully or mechanically attached)
substitutions_proposed.substitute_offered: VE Option 1 — Mechanically attached system in lieu of base-bid fully-adhered
substitutions_proposed.equivalence_justification: For a single-story industrial building in Mississauga (28 ft, parapet walls, sheltered) wind uplift risk is moderate. Mechanically attached systems are widely used in similar applications. Same 20-year NDL warranty available. Trade-off: marginally shorter expected service life (25-28 years vs 30+ years).

substitutions_proposed.spec_item: Cover board (RFP requires 1/4" gypsum or HD polyiso)
substitutions_proposed.substitute_offered: VE Option 5 — No cover board when paired with mechanically attached 80 mil TPO assembly
substitutions_proposed.equivalence_justification: Mechanically attached system does not require cover board per Carlisle and Firestone manufacturer specifications.

materials_system.system_name: TPO single-ply (60 mil base bid; 80 mil under VE Option 3/5)
materials_system.insulation_spec: R-30, two-layer staggered joints (base bid). 1/4" gypsum cover board included in base bid.

technical_approach.narrative: Three-phase approach for occupied, temperature-sensitive industrial facility. Phase 1 (Days 1-18): Office wing 5,100 sq ft. Phase 2 (Days 19-52): Main roof NW section 20,000 sq ft. Phase 3 (Days 53-90): Main roof SE section incl. ponding areas 25,000 sq ft with tapered insulation system. 11 occupied-building references in past 5 years.
technical_approach.tear_off_staging_plan: Maximum 10,000 sq ft exposed at any time (under 15,000 sq ft RFP limit). Each phase watertight by 5:00 PM daily. Two coordination meetings per week during active phases.
technical_approach.weather_protection_plan: Each phase watertight by 5:00 PM daily. Weekend protection: reinforced tarps with weighted edges and secondary drainage.
technical_approach.fall_protection_plan: Annual fall protection training for all workers; COR-certified safety program; dedicated safety coordinator (Marcus Johnson, CRSP).
technical_approach.waste_disposal_plan: Complete legal disposal included in base bid. Lead flashing separated and disposed of as hazardous waste. Visual ACM inspection during removal; up to 100 sq ft non-friable ACM handled under contractor procedures.
technical_approach.hazmat_approach: Visual ACM inspection during removal; $3,500 testing allowance carried; minor non-friable ACM (up to 100 sq ft) handled under contractor procedures; lead flashing disposal included. Major abatement excluded.

extraction_notes: HST treatment: Base bid is $578,000 BEFORE HST (13% = $75,140; total with HST $653,140). HST treatment is explicit, not silent.

Manufacturer not explicitly named in base bid — contractor holds three certifications (Carlisle Syntec Master Installer, Firestone Premier Contractor, GAF Master Elite) but does not commit to a specific manufacturer/system on the base-bid TPO. Owner follow-up needed to confirm which TPO system (and therefore which named NDL warranty) will actually be installed before contract execution. (Section: KEY SPECIFICATIONS, MANUFACTURER CERTIFICATIONS)

Warranty type recorded as 'ndl' per skill taxonomy: bid says '20-year NDL warranty on TPO membrane' and lists 'Sample 20-Year and 30-Year NDL Warranty Sample Documentation' as an attachment — but no manufacturer-specific named system warranty (e.g., Firestone Red Shield Platinum, Carlisle Total System Warranty) is committed to in the bid. Not classified as 'total_system_ndl' since no certified-installer/system-warranty-program prerequisites are documented in this submission.
Workmanship warranty: 2 years stated on installation. May be below RFP minimum — flag for wave-2 RFP comparison.
Wind uplift coverage mph: Not stated in bid. Bid notes for VE Option 1 'slightly more vulnerable to extreme wind events' but provides no mph rating. Owner follow-up needed.

Bid bond: Bonding CAPACITY of $5M per project declared; bid does NOT explicitly state whether a bid bond is attached to this submission. 'Certificate of Insurance' and 'WSIB Clearance Certificate' are listed as attachments but bid bond is not. Owner follow-up needed before mandatory-gate evaluation.
